{"subject":"Predictable p99 for multi-region fraud scoring","body":"Hi Tom,

Northwind Payments runs fraud scoring on Astra DB, a workload that needs single-digit millisecond reads across three regions at 40k transactions per second. Your team also appears focused on evaluating cost and latency improvements for its multi-region data layer.

That is the kind of workload ScyllaDB was built for. Its shard-per-core C++ architecture has no JVM garbage-collection pauses, so p99 latency stays predictable under sustained load.

Would you be open to comparing notes on tail latency for that fraud-scoring path?

Oz
GTM Engineer, ScyllaDB
